Modron - 1.3.0

Additions / Changes

  • [New] Adds Party as a new actor type along with a brand new sheet. The previous party sheet still but will be removed in a couple of updates.
  • [New] Adds automation for v13 movement actions.
  • **[New] ** Adds canvas automation for distance moved.
  • Adds ability to hover a token and see distance from selected token to hovered token.
  • Adds legendary actions data to NPCs. (Server-side only).
  • Adds pill tags for sidebar.
  • Adds cap for die size scaling.
  • Changes max to max formula for uses.
  • Changes roll die size to be a select instead of input.
  • Merges all actor types into one document internally.
  • Upgrades data models for bonuses, abilities, and skills.
  • Removes outdated fancy sheet settings.

Fixes

  • Fixes token sizing issues.
  • Fixes Damage Grant Contexts.
